text:
Caesium fluoride is an ionic compound.
Which statements about caesium fluoride are correct?
1
It conducts electricity when solid.
2
It has a high melting point.
3
It is soluble in water.
4
It is highly volatile.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry
